tldr: Morning batch (Sep 2): Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 launched overnight — Fable 5.1 doubles Terminal-Bench-Science, improves agentic coding 30%+, and cuts long autonomous-run costs by up to 45%, with 60-85% fewer false-positive safeguard interventions in Claude Code sessions. OpenAI's Astra became the first model to hit the Critical cyber-capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, ChatGPT now connects to EHR/healthcare data, and OpenAI detailed how AI-native companies (Basis, Clay, Exa) run agent workflows. Hermes gained a BackSearch plugin for historical-web recall. Anthropic opened its Claude text-watermark detection API to regulators ahead of EU AI Act watermark rules. Research: World Labs' Atlas spatial world model, AI2's BenchMIRT benchmark audit, a paper questioning on-policy distillation, and new Spark-X2.5 small models. Industry: Google DeepMind's chief admits being 'a little bit below the frontier', forensic MacBook evidence surfaces in Apple's OpenAI suit, and Dan Luu audits Ed Zitron's AI-skeptic predictions.
